entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used by the UE to request control plane services from the network.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for NAS messages.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the security protection applied to the NAS message.

entities.name: Control plane service request message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST.

entities.name: Control plane service type
entities.description: Specifies the type of control plane service being requested.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: NAS key set identifier indicating the security context to be used.

entities.name: CIoT small data container
entities.description: Container for small data transmission in CIoT optimizations.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: Indicates the type of payload contained in the payload container.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: Container for carrying payload data such as user data or SMS.

entities.name: PDU session ID
entities.description: Identifies the PDU session for which the service is requested.

entities.name: PDU session status
entities.description: Indicates the status of PDU sessions at the UE.

entities.name: Release assistance indication
entities.description: Provides information to assist the network in connection release decisions.

entities.name: Uplink data status
entities.description: Indicates the uplink data status for PDU sessions.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: Container for encapsulating another NAS message.

entities.name: Additional information
entities.description: Carries additional information related to the service request.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status
entities.description: Indicates the PDU sessions that are allowed by the network.

entities.name: UE request type
entities.description: Indicates the type of request made by the UE.

entities.name: Paging restriction
entities.description: Provides paging restriction information for the UE.
